2609.18333.title: Look Less, Hear Better: Jointly Rewarded GRPO for Streaming ASR
2609.18333.paper_summary: Streaming automatic speech recognition (ASR) must be judged jointly on what it transcribes and on how quickly it commits each word. Delayed streams modeling (DSM) has become the dominant paradigm for streaming large audio-language models, exposing a structural delay $τ$ that bounds the decoder's lookahead. We show that $τ$ is a poor proxy for user-perceived latency, and that the alignment-based supervision of DSM leaves latency on the table: the same forced-aligned transcript is used at every $τ$, forcing the model to withhold words it could already commit. We introduce AWED, a word-level emission-delay metric defined relative to the acoustic end of each word, and post-train a DSM recognizer with GRPO under a reward that scores transcription accuracy and measured delay jointly. Trained at a single operating point ($τ=6$ frames), our model dominates both its supervised fine-tuning initialization and the Voxtral Realtime backbone across all evaluated lookahead budgets: it cuts WER by 30.8\% relative at an 80\,ms structural delay, and by 5.7\% relative at 480\,ms while lowering median AWED from 1.17\,s to 1.04\,s. Latency-rewarded post-training thus advances the accuracy--latency Pareto frontier of streaming ASR without architectural change.
2609.18333.paper_summary_zh: 串流自動語音辨識（ASR）必須根據其轉錄內容和每個單詞的提交速度進行聯合評估。延遲串流建模（DSM）已成為串流大型音頻語言模型的主導範式，暴露出一個結構性延遲 $τ$，該延遲限制了解碼器的前瞻能力。我們展示了 $τ$ 是用戶感知延遲的劣質代理，並且 DSM 的基於對齊的監督使延遲未得到充分利用：在每個 $τ$ 上使用相同的強制對齊轉錄，迫使模型隱藏它已經可以提交的單詞。我們引入了 AWED，一種相對於每個單詞的聲學結尾定義的單詞級發射延遲度量，並在一個獎勵下對 DSM 辨識器進行後訓練，該獎勵共同評分轉錄準確性和測量延遲。在單一操作點（$τ=6$ 幀）上訓練，我們的模型在所有評估的前瞻預算中超越了其監督微調初始化和 Voxtral Realtime 骨幹：在 80\,ms 結構性延遲下將 WER 相對降低 30.8\%，在 480\,ms 下相對降低 5.7\%，同時將中位數 AWED 從 1.17\,s 降低到 1.04\,s。因此，延遲獎勵的後訓練推進了串流 ASR 的準確性-延遲 Pareto 邊界，而無需改變架構。
